title: Clinton ends the Superconducting Super Collider

tellings.quote: On October 30th, 1993, President Clinton signed into law the death blow to the superconducting super collider.

plain: A researcher named Eric Weinstein, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, says that on October 30th, 1993, President Bill Clinton signed into law the "death blow" to the Superconducting Super Collider, a giant American particle physics machine then being built. Weinstein brings it up as a turning point when the United States stepped back from big physics, which matters to him if it shaped what science the country chose to pursue.
